summary: Iteration 52 - P1 Features Testing Complete. All 4 new features working correctly: AI-Powered Intelligent Routing, Client Self-Service Portal, Revenue-per-Ticket Tracking, and Voice-to-Ticket. Backend: 25/25 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All pages load correctly with full functionality.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic only, existing issue from previous iterations
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement opportunity

critical_code_review_comments: Intelligent Routing: Dashboard returns technicians with skills, capacity, stats, and rules. Bulk route and single route both work correctly with reasoning.
Revenue Tracking: Dashboard returns summary with total_revenue, total_cost, total_profit, overall_margin. By-ticket, by-client, by-tech views all work.
Voice-to-Ticket: Transcription correctly detects 'urgent' as critical priority and 'network' as networking category. Ticket creation from voice works.
Client Portal: Config retrieval/update works. Token generation creates shareable URLs. Public endpoints (portal-api/{token}/tickets) work WITHOUT auth.
All data-testid attributes properly implemented across all 4 new pages for testing.
seed_data_creation: Test tokens created for client-001 during testing (cleaned up via revoke)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 52 complete - 4 P1 Features verified. Key data-testids: intelligent-routing-page, bulk-route-btn, add-rule-btn, tech-{id}, rule-{id}, rule-name, save-rule-btn. revenue-tracking-page, view-tickets, view-clients, view-techs, rev-ticket-{id}, rev-client-{name}, rev-tech-{name}. voice-ticket-page, voice-action, voice-record-btn, voice-transcript, voice-process-btn, voice-result. client-portal-page, portal-client-{id}, portal-config-panel, portal-tokens-panel, generate-token-btn, token-contact-name, token-contact-email, confirm-generate-token, new-portal-url. Navigation sidebar includes: Smart Routing, Voice to Ticket, Self-Service Portal, Revenue/Ticket.

1_intelligent_routing_dashboard.details: GET /api/intelligent-routing/dashboard returns technicians with skills/capacity/stats and routing rules. Shows 4 techs, 5 rules.

2_route_single_ticket.details: POST /api/intelligent-routing/route-ticket/{id} assigns ticket with reasoning (capacity%, skill%, availability%). Returns confidence score and alternatives.

3_bulk_route.details: POST /api/intelligent-routing/bulk-route routes all unassigned tickets. Returns routed/failed counts and results array.

4_routing_rules_crud.details: POST /api/intelligent-routing/rules creates rules. DELETE /api/intelligent-routing/rules/{id} removes them. Rules have enabled toggle.

5_revenue_dashboard.details: GET /api/revenue-tracking/dashboard returns summary (total_revenue, total_cost, total_profit, overall_margin), tickets array, by_client, by_tech.

6_revenue_by_ticket.details: Ticket revenue includes: total_revenue, total_cost, profit, margin_pct, labor_revenue, parts_revenue, billable_minutes.

7_revenue_by_client.details: Client revenue includes: client_name, tickets count, revenue, cost, profit, margin_pct. 13 clients displayed.

8_revenue_by_tech.details: Tech revenue includes: tech_name, tickets count, revenue, cost, profit, margin_pct, revenue_per_hour. 5 technicians displayed.

9_voice_transcribe_action.details: POST /api/voice-ticket/transcribe with action='transcribe' extracts priority and category from text. Returns confidence score.

10_voice_urgent_detection.details: Voice transcription correctly detects 'urgent' keyword as critical priority.

11_voice_network_detection.details: Voice transcription correctly detects 'network' keyword as networking category.

12_voice_create_ticket.details: POST /api/voice-ticket/transcribe with action='create' creates ticket from voice text. Returns ticket with source='voice'.

13_client_portal_config.details: GET /api/client-portal/config/{id} returns portal config with branding and features. PUT updates settings.

14_generate_portal_token.details: POST /api/client-portal/generate-token/{id} creates access token. Returns token value and portal_url for sharing.

15_public_portal_tickets.details: GET /api/portal-api/{token}/tickets works WITHOUT auth (public endpoint). Returns client tickets array.

16_public_portal_info.details: GET /api/portal-api/{token}/info works WITHOUT auth. Returns client info, branding, features.

17_frontend_intelligent_routing.details: IntelligentRoutingPage loads with technician cards (skills, capacity bars, SLA/CSAT), routing rules with toggles, and Add Rule dialog.

18_frontend_revenue_tracking.details: RevenueTrackingPage loads with summary cards (Total Revenue, Cost, Profit, Margin), ticket profit table, view switching (Tickets/Clients/Techs).

19_frontend_voice_ticket.details: VoiceTicketPage loads with recording interface (mic button), action selector, transcript textarea, Quick Tips sidebar. Ticket creation shows result with AI Detected badges.

20_frontend_client_portal.details: ClientPortalPage loads with client list, portal config panel (branding, features toggles), token generation. Generated token URL displayed for copying.

mocked_apis.note: Revenue calculations use mocked values for tickets without time entries. Routing skill scores include randomized components. Voice transcription uses keyword-based extraction (not real AI).
